transcript.statement: Safety is paramount in the ATM system to protect users from financial loss and ensure reliable operations. SAF-01 prevents negative balances, ensuring users do not inadvertently overdraw. SAF-02 ensures automatic fund transfers from savings for seamless transactions. SAF-03 guarantees user notifications to prevent confusion during low funds. SAF-04 logs transactions for accountability and auditing. SAF-05 secures user authentication via PIN, preventing unauthorized access. SAF-06 allows limited withdrawals during maintenance, maintaining service reliability. SAF-07 provides users with clear transaction summaries, enhancing trust and understanding of their financial status.

transcript.statement: The ethical and compliance aspects are crucial for the ATM system to ensure accountability and fairness in financial transactions. RES-01 guarantees adherence to financial regulations, protecting both users and the institution. RES-02 mandates detailed transaction logs for transparency, reinforcing accountability. RES-03 prevents negative balances, ensuring fair treatment of all users. RES-04 secures user identity through a PIN mechanism, promoting trust. RES-05 ensures funds are only withdrawn when available, protecting users from overdrafts. RES-06 provides timely notifications of insufficient funds, ensuring users are informed. RES-07 guarantees user privacy through encryption, aligning with social responsibility principles.

conflicts_raised.description: These requirements prevent negative balances but are redundant with RES-03.
Automatically withdrawing funds may lead to a lack of transparency in user transactions.
Notifying users of insufficient funds may conflict with the requirement to inform after a transaction is terminated.

transcript.statement: Performance efficiency is critical for ensuring that users have a seamless experience with the ATM system. EFF-01 ensures transactions are processed quickly, enhancing user satisfaction. EFF-02 guarantees high throughput to handle busy times effectively. EFF-03 focuses on optimizing data retrieval for quicker access to transaction history. EFF-04 complements SAF-01 by preventing negative balances while prioritizing performance. EFF-05 ensures no user delays in fund withdrawals, maintaining responsiveness. EFF-06 provides immediate feedback on withdrawal requests, essential for user awareness. EFF-07 implements load balancing to manage transaction requests, optimizing resource usage.

conflicts_raised.description: These requirements overlap with EFF-04 in preventing negative balances.

transcript.statement: Trustworthiness is essential for user confidence in the ATM system. TRU-01 ensures encryption of all transactions, safeguarding data during transmission. TRU-02 reinforces user authentication through a secure PIN, preventing unauthorized access. TRU-03 mandates transaction logging for auditability, ensuring accountability. TRU-04 prevents negative balances, critical for financial integrity. TRU-05 allows users to securely review transaction history, enhancing transparency. TRU-06 ensures timely notifications of insufficient funds, informing users before transactions proceed. TRU-07 maintains data integrity by validating operations, which is vital for secure user experience.

conflicts_raised.description: These requirements also prevent negative balances, creating redundancy with TRU-04.

transcript.statement: Sustainability is crucial for the ATM system to minimize environmental impact. GRN-01 focuses on reducing energy consumption through optimized transaction processing. GRN-02 ensures transparency by providing a carbon footprint report for each transaction, promoting awareness of environmental effects. GRN-03 mandates the use of energy-efficient hardware for lower resource usage. GRN-04 prioritizes data storage optimization to decrease resource impact. GRN-05 offers clients an eco-friendly alternative to paper receipts. GRN-06 conserves energy by shutting down during inactivity. GRN-07 emphasizes annual assessments of environmental impact, ensuring ongoing improvement in sustainability practices.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure that no account can have a negative balance.
The system shall automatically withdraw funds from the related saving account with mandatory user notification and acknowledgment.
The system shall inform the user and terminate the transaction if the saving account balance is insufficient for the withdrawal.
The system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
The system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The system shall provide users with a clear summary of account status after each transaction.
The ATM system shall process transactions within 3 seconds to ensure user responsiveness.
The system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
The ATM application shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.
The system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
The ATM system shall ensure energy-efficient operation by optimizing transaction processing.
The ATM system shall provide insights into the carbon footprint of transactions during notifications.
The ATM system shall use energy-efficient hardware components to operate.
The system shall ensure all transactions comply with applicable financial regulations and standards.
The application shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.
